body_markdown:
# Introduction

This lesson provides short passages for listening practice. Ask someone to read each passage aloud, or use a text-to-speech tool. If you are practising alone, listen without looking at the passage first. Then answer the questions.

## Passage 1: A morning routine

“I wake up at six o'clock every morning. I drink a glass of water and go for a short walk. After returning home, I take a bath and have breakfast. I leave for work at eight thirty.”

**1. What time does the speaker wake up?**

A. 5 o'clock  
B. 6 o'clock  
C. 8 o'clock

**2. What does the speaker do after drinking water?**

A. Goes for a walk  
B. Goes to work  
C. Reads a book

**3. When does the speaker leave for work?**

A. 7:30  
B. 8:00  
C. 8:30

## Passage 2: A visit to the doctor

“Meena was not feeling well, so she visited a doctor on Tuesday morning. The doctor checked her temperature and advised her to rest and drink enough water. Meena collected the prescribed medicine from the pharmacy.”

**4. Why did Meena visit the doctor?**

A. She was not feeling well  
B. She wanted to travel  
C. She needed a book

**5. When did she visit the doctor?**

A. Monday evening  
B. Tuesday morning  
C. Friday afternoon

**6. What did the doctor advise?**

A. To run quickly  
B. To work all night  
C. To rest and drink enough water

## Passage 3: A workplace announcement

“Attention, team members. The training session will begin at ten thirty in the conference room. Please bring your notebook and arrive five minutes early.”

**7. What time will the session begin?**

A. 10:00  
B. 10:30  
C. 11:30

**8. Where will it take place?**

A. Conference room  
B. Canteen  
C. Reception gate

**9. What should team members bring?**

A. A suitcase  
B. A notebook  
C. A uniform only

**10. When should they arrive?**

A. Five minutes early  
B. Thirty minutes late  
C. At lunchtime

## Answer key

1. B  
2. A  
3. C  
4. A  
5. B  
6. C  
7. B  
8. A  
9. B  
10. A

## How to practise

1. Listen once without reading.
2. Answer the questions from memory.
3. Listen a second time and check details.
4. Read the passage and notice any missed words.
5. Repeat the passage aloud.

## Score guide

- 9–10: Very good listening comprehension practice.
- 6–8: Good progress. Listen again for details.
- 0–5: Use shorter passages and practise identifying names, times and places.

This is a guided text-based activity, not an independently recorded audio examination.

faq.question: Do I need an audio file for this quiz?
faq.answer: No audio file is embedded. Ask someone to read the passages or use a text-to-speech tool.

faq.question: How many times should I listen?
faq.answer: Try once for the main idea and a second time for specific details.

faq.question: Should I read the passage while listening?
faq.answer: First listen without reading if possible, then use the text to review missed information.
